title: TRACE-ECG emulation-quality framework v2.0: item list and per-trial scoring template
status: draft for user confirmation; no trial scored
scope: Stage 2 of trial selection (38 emulated -> analysed set) for paper 1. Stage 1 (feasibility, 99 -> 38) unchanged.
principles: Results (HRs, CIs, agreement, balance/SMD, matched-pair counts, plasmode, ECG/CLMBR-T effects, R2/LEGEND results) are never a scoring criterion; every score cites SPEC/CODE/PUB/DATA evidence.
Each deviation is scored once (allocation table, framework section 5).
Documented adaptations are scored in domain items; undocumented, correctable defects only in SI by share affected; placebo proxy always in CO.
Score the code path that built the analysed cohort, citing spec key and spec_version.
Known deviation of unknown magnitude -> middle level, provisional; arm-assignment/time-zero mechanism -> 2 provisional; resolve provisional scores before freezing.
Examples in anchors are illustrative, not scores.

evidence_types.SPEC: file:line @ git SHA, spec key, spec_version
evidence_types.DOC: repo document; pointer only, never sole support

items.name: Eligibility fidelity
items.definition: Match of the emulated population to the trial's population-defining criteria (disease/index event, severity or phenotype, risk enrichment, age bounds, required prior/background therapy). Safety exclusions are scored only if their omission plausibly changes the population materially.

levels.label: faithful
levels.anchor: All population-defining criteria represented (exactly or by accepted proxy), or any omitted criterion would be met by >=90% of the emulated population anyway (DC-EL-met or stated clinical reasoning).

levels.label: one criterion
levels.anchor: Exactly one population-defining criterion omitted or approximated in a way that changes who is included.
examples_illustrative: risk enrichment not applied (CAROLINA high CV risk; REWIND CVD/risk factors; LEADER >=60 risk-factor stratum)
new-user restriction excludes a large experienced subgroup the trial enrolled (ARISTOTLE VKA-experienced), unless it is a switch at randomisation (TZ.c)

levels.label: different population
levels.anchor: Two or more population-defining criteria omitted/approximated, or the defining phenotype has no usable EHR proxy so the emulated population is a different clinical population.

evidence_required: DATA: DC-EL-met when the >=90% rule is invoked
items.unknown_rule: Impact of an omitted criterion unknown -> 1, provisional.

items.name: Time-zero alignment
items.definition: Whether time zero is the same decision point as randomisation (eligibility met, strategy assigned). Scored from four present/absent features.

features.name: In-hospital initiation not mirrored
features.present_when: Trial started/randomised treatment during a hospital stay and emulated time zero cannot be placed at the equivalent in-hospital decision point (e.g. oral discharge strategy vs an inpatient IV order of the comparator drug: TRANSFORM-HF).
features.not_scored_when: Inpatient orders visible and time zero is the in-hospital start in both arms (PLATO, VALIANT, PROVE IT-TIMI 22; LAAOS III surgery in both arms).

features.name: Selective run-in
features.present_when: An active run-in before randomisation removed patients for intolerance, non-adherence or non-response to a study drug (PARADIGM-HF, ONTARGET).
features.not_scored_when: Placebo or washout run-in that did not select on response to a study drug (LIFE, INSIGHT).

features.name: Baseline same-purpose therapy switched at randomisation, not reproduced
features.present_when: >=30% of randomised patients were on a same-purpose drug stopped or replaced at randomisation and the emulation neither requires nor reproduces that switch.
features.not_scored_when: Switch during a pre-randomisation washout/run-in; post-randomisation protocol transition window (INR-guided VKA-to-DOAC: ARISTOTLE, ROCKET-AF); switch/sequential design reproduces it (FRAIL-AF, PARADIGM-HF sequential, PROTECT AF); share <30%.
features.escalation: Share >=50% -> TZ = 2 on its own (not applied when the share is unknown).

features.name: Other misalignment incl. immortal time
features.present_when: Eligibility uses post-time-zero information; unequal person-time at risk before assignment (immortal time); or the arms' time zeros are at non-equivalent points of the disease course (check procedure-vs-drug designs, e.g. CABANA).
features.not_scored_when: A sequential prevalent new-user comparator sampled at the switch date without future information.
features.escalation: Immortal time not removed by design -> TZ = 2.

levels.label: aligned
levels.anchor: No feature present.

levels.label: one feature
levels.anchor: Exactly one feature present.

levels.label: misaligned
levels.anchor: Two or more features; or TZ.c with >=50% switched; or immortal time not removed by design.

evidence_required: PUB: setting and timing of randomisation; run-in and share excluded; baseline medication table (TZ.c)
items.unknown_rule: TZ.c share unreported: use design paper/baseline table; if still unknown, present only when eligibility required/implied prior same-purpose therapy (provisional); no >=50% escalation on an unknown share.

items.name: Intervention-strategy identifiability
items.definition: Whether the intervention strategy can be identified from orders/procedures. Comparator arm is scored in CO.

levels.label: identified
levels.anchor: Trial agent/procedure identified (or trial allowed any class agent and the class is used, e.g. FRAIL-AF any DOAC); dose/formulation does not define the contrast or marketed dose = trial dose. Dose titration of a fixed agent is not scored.

levels.label: approximated
levels.anchor: Class adaptation; strategy approximated by its first identifiable component; trial formulation not identifiable but plausibly not hypothesis-changing; dose/intensity contrast largely preserved by routine practice with evidence.
examples_illustrative: rhythm control = antiarrhythmic initiation (AFFIRM, AF-CHF, EAST-AFNET 4)

levels.label: not identifiable
levels.anchor: The hypothesis depends on an unidentifiable strategy feature: an arm-defining co-therapy (ACTIVE W clopidogrel plus aspirin) or a dose/intensity contrast with no evidence that practice preserves it.

evidence_required: practice-pattern source or DATA for the 'preserved by practice' clause
items.unknown_rule: Unclear whether practice preserves the contrast -> 1, provisional.

items.name: Comparator fidelity
items.definition: Whether the comparator strategy reproduces the trial's comparator.

levels.label: same comparator
levels.anchor: Trial comparator agent/procedure (or allowed set) observable and used; 'continue current therapy' comparators sampled as established users by a sequential design (FRAIL-AF, PROTECT AF).

levels.label: adapted
levels.anchor: Comparator class adaptation; comparator strategy narrower/broader than the trial's; comparator defined by absence of an under-recorded code; documented inherent contamination not removable with available data.

levels.label: placebo proxy or changed hypothesis
levels.anchor: Placebo-controlled trial emulated with an active comparator assumed null (DPP-4i or sulfonylurea proxies); a substitution that changes the hypothesis; or a comparator with its own established, non-removable effect on the primary outcome.

items.sets_flag: placebo_proxy = true when CO = 2 because of a placebo proxy
items.v19_source: comparator fidelity (comparator-arm part; placebo proxy = poor)

items.name: Outcome fidelity
items.definition: Ascertainability and definition of the trial's primary endpoint in the emulation.

levels.label: faithful
levels.anchor: All components ascertained as coded hospitalisations, coded procedures or all-cause death, index stay excluded, matching the trial definition.

levels.label: approximated
levels.anchor: Any of: cause-specific death required (CV/vascular/CHD death from listed causes; always 1); a non-dominant component (<33% of RCT primary events, not the most frequent) missing or approximated; inpatient-only ascertainment where the trial counted outpatient events in a minor share; index-stay/peri-procedural events excluded in a minor share (LAAOS III). Level-1 features do not add to 2.

levels.label: not validly ascertained
levels.anchor: The dominant component (most frequent or >=33% of RCT primary events) not ascertainable with available data (FRAIL-AF CRNM bleeding); inpatient-only ascertainment misses a large share (AMPLIFY outpatient DVT and VTE-related death); or a materially different construct.

items.dominance_threshold: most frequent component, or >=33% of RCT primary events
evidence_required: PUB: component table / first events by component
eTable 1 / Table 1 notes checked against code (CABANA footnote)
items.unknown_rule: Component shares unpublished: use total component counts; else assume non-dominant unless the most frequent in comparable trials (provisional).

items.name: Follow-up horizon and delayed effect
items.definition: Trial-matched horizon vs benchmark follow-up; long horizon under an ITT-like estimand.

features.name: Horizon mismatch
features.present_when: HORIZON_MONTHS / benchmark median (or primary-analysis) follow-up outside 0.75-1.33 (e.g. TRANSFORM-HF).

levels.label: aligned
levels.anchor: <48 months and ratio within 0.75-1.33.

levels.label: misaligned
levels.anchor: FU.a or FU.b present.

evidence_required: PUB: median follow-up of the benchmark analysis
items.unknown_rule: Median follow-up unreported: use mean or planned follow-up and record which.

items.name: Estimand alignment
items.definition: Whether the initiation (ITT-like) estimand matches the benchmark's, and whether routine-care crossover changes the contrast.

features.name: Per-protocol/on-treatment benchmark
features.present_when: Registered benchmark is per-protocol or on-treatment (e.g. TECOS).

features.name: Excess crossover
features.present_when: Share of either arm starting the other arm's strategy within the horizon (DC-ES-cross) exceeds the trial's reported crossover by >=20 percentage points (assume <=10% in blinded drug trials if unreported).

levels.label: aligned
levels.anchor: ITT/mITT benchmark and no excess crossover.

levels.label: misaligned
levels.anchor: ES.a or ES.b present.

items.unknown_rule: DC-ES-cross unavailable: ES.b = 0 unless a specific documented mechanism (secular replacement of comparator by intervention) -> 1 provisional.

items.name: Benchmark quality
items.definition: Whether the RCT benchmark is a usable, comparable target for an emulated Cox HR. Never triggers a cap.

features.name: Measure other than HR
features.present_when: RR, rate ratio, subdistribution HR or OR.

features.name: Non-isolable benchmark arm/dose/co-primary
features.present_when: Benchmark refers to an arm, dose or co-primary endpoint the emulation cannot isolate (check RE-LY, DECLARE-TIMI 58).

features.name: Transcription/orientation discrepancy
features.present_when: PUBLISHED differs from the publication in value, CI or orientation (check COMET).

levels.label: usable
levels.anchor: ITT HR with frequentist CI for the emulated endpoint, transcribed and oriented correctly. CI level other than 95% is not scored.

levels.label: limited
levels.anchor: Any BM feature present.

items.name: Data adequacy
items.definition: Measurability of population-defining variables in the EHR; size and events (pre-matching, pooled).

features.name: Population-defining measurement mostly unknown
features.present_when: Population-defining criterion that depends on a measurement (LVEF, ECG-LVH text, population-defining eGFR) measured in <50% of the analysed cohort (DC-DA-meas).

features.name: Small arm or few events
features.present_when: Smaller arm <500 patients with ECG, or pooled primary-outcome events within the horizon <100 (DC-DA-size).

levels.label: adequate
levels.anchor: Neither feature.

levels.label: limited
levels.anchor: DA.a or DA.b present.

items.unknown_rule: Data check not run: 1 provisional only when DA.a applies by design (EF-defined trial); otherwise 0.

items.name: Specification and implementation fidelity (undocumented defects)
items.definition: Whether the code that built the analysed cohort implements the protocol and the documented adaptations, verified against data; scored by the share affected.

defect_types.name: Arm tokens/codes
examples: formulation brand token in an arm labelled otherwise (toprol in a metoprolol-tartrate arm)
ARNI orders tokenised as valsartan in an ARB arm (ELITE II, VALIANT)

defect_types.name: Removable comparator contamination
examples: saxagliptin/alogliptin in a DPP-4i proxy for an HF endpoint

defect_types.name: Missing numeric bounds
examples: protocol age range absent from spec (CAROLINA 40-85)

defect_types.name: Gate errors
examples: index-stay codes satisfy a pre-existing-condition gate (LAAOS III post-operative AF)
measurement window misses the relevant day

defect_types.name: Outcome code lists
examples: persisting index-event codes counted as events (AMPLIFY)

defect_types.name: Arm assignment / time zero in code
examples: dedupe/ordering rule assigning patients to the wrong arm or index date (R2 CABANA flag)

items.share_rule: Share whose arm, eligibility, time zero, or event status/time would change if the defect were corrected. Several defects on one denominator: union share; if only per-defect shares are known, their sum (conservative).

levels.label: none
levels.anchor: No undocumented defect, or affected share <5%.

levels.label: minor
levels.anchor: Affected share 5-20%.

levels.label: major
levels.anchor: >20% affected, or an arm-assignment/time-zero error that cannot be fixed by excluding the affected patients.

evidence_required: CODE/SPEC: exact line and proposed edit
items.unknown_rule: Share unchecked -> 1 provisional; arm-assignment/time-zero mechanism -> 2 provisional.

definitions.PP: placebo_proxy flag (CO = 2 because of a placebo proxy)

tier_rules.rebuild_rule: A trial Limited only because of SI is re-scored after a rebuild fixing the defect; it enters the analysed set only by a dated amendment committed before any analysis of the new set.

data_checks.quantity: Share of analysed patients (or primary-outcome events for outcome defects) affected by each suspected undocumented defect
Share of analysed cohort with the population-defining measurement in its window
Smaller-arm size (patients with ECG); pooled primary events within horizon
Share of each arm starting the other arm's strategy within horizon
Share of analysed cohort meeting an omitted, code-approximable criterion anyway

data_check_output_dir: /mnt/raid0/rbc58/ecg-tte/audits/emulation_quality_v2/data_checks/ (umask 077; bands only in repo; counts 1-10 suppressed incl. derivable)

reliability_reporting.also_report: item prevalence; rater identity (LLM runs reported as such)

v19_mapping.comparator_fidelity: CO (comparator arm) + TS (intervention arm); placebo proxy = CO 2

record_schema.description: One record per trial per record_type (rater_A, rater_B, adjudicated). item.score is an integer within the item's levels; features hold true/false; total and tier are computed mechanically from items by tier_rules.
